## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-3: A reusable protocol-conformance test harness exists that any touchpoint can invoke to assert: exactly MAX_CYCLES dispatches on forced failure, no cycle MAX_CYCLES+1, correct REPLAN_ESCALATE upstream token, OSCILLATION_HALT on detected oscillation, PROTOCOL_ERROR on illegal state transitions

## Description

Create `tests/lib/protocol-conformance-harness.sh` — a parameterized bash script touchpoint tests invoke as `protocol-conformance-harness.sh --touchpoint=<name> --simulate-failure --max-cycles=N`. The harness drives a synthetic loop runner via fixtures and asserts (using `tests/lib/assert.sh` helpers): (a) exactly N dispatches occur on forced failure, (b) the loop never reaches cycle N+1, (c) on cycle-N failure the runner emits `REPLAN_ESCALATE:` with a valid upstream enum token (brainstorm|preplanning|planner_supplied), (d) on forced-oscillation fixture the runner emits `OSCILLATION_HALT`, (e) on illegal state transitions the runner emits `PROTOCOL_ERROR`. Also create `tests/lib/protocol-conformance-baseline.txt` as a deterministic baseline of expected emitted-token sequences for the standard fixtures.

## TDD Test Spec

Given the harness invoked as `protocol-conformance-harness.sh --touchpoint=fixture-a --simulate-failure --max-cycles=3`; When the synthetic loop is driven against the always-failing fixture; Then exactly 3 dispatch lines are recorded, no 4th dispatch occurs, and the final emitted token is `REPLAN_ESCALATE:<upstream>` where `<upstream>` matches one of (brainstorm|preplanning|planner_supplied). Given the forced-oscillation fixture; When invoked with --max-cycles=3; Then `OSCILLATION_HALT` is emitted before cycle 3. Given a fixture that forces an illegal state transition; When invoked; Then `PROTOCOL_ERROR` is emitted and the harness exits non-zero.

## File Impact

| Source | Action | Tests |
|--------|--------|-------|
| tests/lib/protocol-conformance-harness.sh | Create | tests/unit/shared/test-protocol-conformance-harness.sh (Create) |
| tests/lib/protocol-conformance-baseline.txt | Create | (data file — no test) |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Harness file is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/lib/protocol-conformance-harness.sh
- [ ] Harness exits 0 and records exactly MAX_CYCLES dispatches on forced-failure fixture
  Verify: bash tests/unit/shared/test-protocol-conformance-harness.sh
- [ ] Harness emits REPLAN_ESCALATE with valid upstream enum token (brainstorm|preplanning|planner_supplied) on cycle-MAX_CYCLES failure
  Verify: bash tests/unit/shared/test-protocol-conformance-harness.sh
- [ ] Harness emits OSCILLATION_HALT on forced-oscillation fixture
  Verify: bash tests/unit/shared/test-protocol-conformance-harness.sh
- [ ] Harness emits PROTOCOL_ERROR and exits non-zero on illegal state transition fixture
  Verify: bash tests/unit/shared/test-protocol-conformance-harness.sh
- [ ] Harness rejects MAX_CYCLES<2 with clear error (mirrors config-key contract)
  Verify: ! bash tests/lib/protocol-conformance-harness.sh --touchpoint=fixture-a --simulate-failure --max-cycles=1
- [ ] `.test-index` updated with RED marker for the new test file
  Verify: grep -q 'test-protocol-conformance-harness' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
